observations: Photo 0 shows a used engine with a black intake manifold and a silver engine block.
The engine is surrounded by other used engine components and a cardboard box.
A handwritten marking 'AA24' is visible on the black intake manifold in photo 0.
Photo 1 shows the same engine from a different angle, confirming the presence of a black intake manifold.
The engine appears to be a 2.5L V6, consistent with the IS250 and GS250 models.
The engine is shown in a scrapyard or workshop environment.

claims.claim: Complete engine for lexus IS250 and GS250
claims.evidence: The engine is shown in photo 0 and 1, but the seller cannot confirm if it is a complete unit for a specific Lexus model.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The engine may not be a genuine Lexus part or may be a generic aftermarket unit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine identification plate (usually on the block or intake manifold).

risks.risk: The engine may be missing essential components like the crankshaft pulley or oil pan.
risks.proof: A photo showing all engine components attached to the block.

risks.risk: The engine may have internal mechanical damage or high compression.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running or a compression test result.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine identification plate showing the VIN or part number.
Photo of the crankshaft pulley and oil pan to confirm all parts are included.
Video of the engine running or a compression test result.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
